create_Trial: create a Trial with a Condition and list of Stimulus objects for an experiment
end_Trial: end a Trial to finalize all associated stimuli and record results
create_ExperimentState: create an ExperimentState dataclass to track trial results across an experiment
create_BaseCondition: create a BaseCondition enum with EXPERIMENT_START for marking experiment lifecycle events
create_ReadyMessage: create a ReadyMessage labgraph message with a boolean ready flag for node signaling
